title: Use Seedance 2.5 to create a one-take continuous shot by prompting for a single…
content: Use Seedance 2.5 to create a one-take continuous shot by prompting for a single continuous camera move (no cuts, no compositing) through a consistent location while the scene rewinds/ages over time.
tips: Use Seedance 2.5 to create a one-take continuous shot by prompting for a single continuous camera move (no cuts, no compositing) through a consistent location while the scene rewinds/ages over time.

es.content: Usa Seedance 2.5 para crear un plano secuencia continuo, indicando un único movimiento de cámara continuo (sin cortes ni compositing) a través de una ubicación coherente mientras la escena se rebobina o envejece con el tiempo.

fr.content: Utilisez Seedance 2.5 pour créer un plan-séquence en une seule prise en demandant un mouvement de caméra continu unique (sans coupe, sans compositing) dans un lieu cohérent, tandis que la scène remonte le temps / vieillit au fil du temps.

ja.content: Seedance 2.5 を使って、シーンが時間の経過とともに巻き戻る／老いていく中で、一貫したロケーションを通して単一の連続したカメラ移動（カットなし、合成なし）を指示し、ワンテイクの連続ショットを作成します。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5를 사용해, 하나의 연속적인 카메라 움직임(컷 없음, 합성 없음)으로 일관된 장소를 따라가며 장면이 시간의 흐름에 따라 되감기되거나 노화되는 원테이크 연속 샷을 생성하세요.

pt.content: Use o Seedance 2.5 para criar um plano-sequência contínuo, solicitando um único movimento de câmera contínuo (sem cortes, sem composição) por um local consistente enquanto a cena retrocede/envelhece ao longo do tempo.

zh.content: 使用 Seedance 2.5，通过提示一个单一、连续的镜头运动（无剪切、无合成），在一个一致的场景中拍摄一镜到底的连续镜头，同时让场景随着时间倒放/老化。
